committee: Joint Select Committee on Blockchain, Financial Technology and Digital Innovation Technology
location: University of Wyoming Wyoming Union, Room 212 1000 E. University Ave.
title: The purpose of this meeting is to continue the Select Committee's interim work. The Select Committee will receive updates from the Wyoming Stable Token Commission, the Office of U.S. Senator Cynthia Lummis, and the University of Wyoming. The Select Committee will discuss bill drafts related to the Wyoming Digital Asset Authority, data privacy, artificial intelligence, automatic license plate readers, the Model Money Transmission Modernization Act, virtual currency kiosks, and public utilities.
